picks.editorial_note: MIT's Barzilay and Collins won the prestigious 2026 Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark recognition of AI's real-world impact on combating drug-resistant infections.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a five-year, $24.5 million NSF-funded national infrastructure project to support AI-driven science, representing a major federal investment and multi-institutional partnership.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team's AI-guided vaccine design technique achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, demonstrating a tangible breakthrough with direct global health implications.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health
